notes: Configurations: with_skill = v4 (adds: when a known issue or PR records the constraint or decision being written down, add its id after the fact as a pointer, never instead of it; give a TODO or hack its tracking issue; do not tag code with the issue that changed it). old_skill = v3. without_skill = no skill. For the nine iteration-3 cases, old_skill and without_skill are the iteration-3 runs, reused; all 22 with_skill runs and the 8 runs of the two new cases are fresh.

Pass rates (mean of per-run rates): v4 97.7%, v3 97.0%, no skill 91.4%. Raw checks: v4 115/118, v3 114/118, no skill 107/118. The no-skill drop from iteration 3 (95.0%) comes from the new pointer case, not from a change in old results.

Targeted gain on issue-pointer-beside-reason: v4 cited #212 next to the vendor reason in 2/2 runs; v3 and no skill in 0/2 each, although both recorded the reason itself. Scores: v4 5/6 and 6/6, v3 5/6 and 4/6, no skill 3/6 and 3/6.

Common failure on the pointer case, across every configuration: rewriting the existing docstring 'Return value formatted for the export file.' instead of leaving it and adding the reason (kept_all failed in v4 r1, v3 r2 and both no-skill runs). No-skill runs also added five comment lines, over the case's limit of four.

no-issue-tag-routine does not discriminate: no configuration tagged the --limit code with #318 (5/5 in all six runs). It guards against the new rule causing tagging; it does not show the rule prevents it.

Regression to watch on reason-only-in-test: v4 r1 simplified the loop and added no comment, saying in its reply that it found no reason for the ordering, although the test holds it (4/6). v4 r2 recorded rule and reason (6/6). v3 scored 6/6 and 5/6 in iteration 3. With two runs this is within run-to-run variance seen before; no override applied.
Every with_skill run read SKILL.md as its first tool call; none was excluded.

Run isolation: two runs wrote helper scripts outside their outputs folder (reason-only-in-test with_skill r2: equiv/check.py; no-issue-tag-routine without_skill r1: limit-check/). These were deleted after the run; grading reads only outputs/, so scores are unaffected. __pycache__ folders inside outputs were removed before grading.
Duration outliers (about 145 s) are in reused iteration-3 runs, not in the fresh ones. Fresh v4 runs took 15-29 s. Tokens: v4 and v3 about 43.0k, no skill about 40.4k.
